def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    species_map = {'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'}
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace(species_map)
    # Fix island case variant

    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range values (likely stored in mg instead of g)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Drop rows where body_mass_g is still out of range or missing
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
